title: Grateful Dead Live at Cumberland County Civic Center on 1982-09-17
source: Source Info: Jim Wise's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 421 mics > Sony TC-D5 (Maxell XLII-S); Transfer Info: Master Cassettes (Nakamichi Dragon)> Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz) > dBpoweramp (24-bit/96 kHz) > Adobe Audition 3.01 (24-bit/96 kHz) > TLH flac2496

ai_review.summary: Excellent front‑of‑house soundboard capture with high‑energy performance, though Brent’s mic is mysteriously absent.
ai_review.review: The reviewer rates both the setlist and the audio five stars, calling this FOB recording “as good as F O B can get.” The show is described as an awesome, high‑energy experience, but the only technical quibble is the lack of a microphone for Brent Mydland, leaving his keyboards and background vocals unrecorded. Overall, listeners are told they won’t be disappointed.

ai_rating.rationale: A single enthusiastic five‑star review praises both the musical performance and the soundboard quality, leading to a high combined rating despite limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp front‑of‑house mix praised as top‑tier; however, Brent Mydland’s keyboard and vocal mic were missing, resulting in absent keys/vocals on the recording.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Set list receives five stars; flow considered solid and enjoyable.

band_member_comments.Keys: Reviewer notes no microphone was set up for Brent Mydland on this night, so keyboards/vocals are missing from the mix.
